The same reading with dizziness, blurred vision, or fainting has causes that can be found.</p><p class="intro-lead"><strong>Low blood pressure</strong>, meaning under 90/60 mmHg, isn't a disease in itself. If you have no symptoms, the guidelines are clear that it doesn't need treatment. The problem appears when blood pressure drops by 20 mmHg or more on standing up and brings on dizziness, blacked-out vision, or fainting. In that case, the right response on the spot is to sit or lie down with your legs raised, drink water, and cross your legs while tensing your muscles. Sugar water, vitamins, and teas don't appear in any guideline. Fainting with chest pain, laboured breathing, or confusion means calling 112.</p><div class="hero-facts"><span class="hero-fact">Under 90/60 mmHg with no symptoms: usually doesn't need treatment</span><span class="hero-fact">A drop of 20/10 mmHg on standing, within 3 minutes: orthostatic hypotension</span><span class="hero-fact">On the spot: sit or lie down, legs raised, water, tensed muscles</span></div><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn-lime" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241">ESC guideline for syncope</a><a class="btn-ghost" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Normal blood pressure by age</a></div></div><aside class="hero-panel"><span class="meta-chip">The right order</span><p class="intro-support">Measure correctly for seven days before calling yourself hypotensive.</p><p class="intro-support">Look for the cause before the remedy: dehydration, heat, a new medication, a large meal.</p><p class="intro-support">Repeated fainting needs investigating, not treating with coffee.</p><div class="hero-author"><div aria-hidden="true" class="hero-author-mark">GH</div><div><strong>Global Health Medical Team</strong></div></div><span class="hero-review-line">Reviewed by the Global Health medical team.</span></aside></header><nav class="article-nav"><div class="article-nav-inner"><span class="article-nav-label">In this guide</span><div class="article-nav-list"><a href="#ce-inseamna">What it means</a><a href="#cauze">Causes</a><a href="#pe-loc">What to do right away</a><a href="#ce-nu-ajuta">What doesn't help</a><a href="#cand-la-medic">When to see a doctor</a><a href="#faq">FAQ</a></div></div></nav><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-inseamna" /><span class="eyebrow">Definitions</span><h2>What low blood pressure means, and when it matters</h2><p class="section-lead">The same term covers two different situations, and only one of them needs treatment.</p><p>The first is constantly low blood pressure, under 90/60 mmHg, in someone who feels fine. The NHS and NHLBI say the same thing: with no symptoms, it usually isn't treated. The second is orthostatic hypotension: the European guideline defines it as a drop in systolic pressure of at least 20 mmHg, or in diastolic pressure of 10 mmHg, within the first 3 minutes after standing up. This is what causes the dizziness on getting out of bed and the blackout in front of your eyes, and this is the one worth investigating.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018 guideline for syncope</a>, <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — low blood pressure</a>, <a href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI</a>. Accessed 7 September 2026.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cauze" /><span class="eyebrow">Where it comes from</span><h2>Common causes of low blood pressure</h2><p class="section-lead">Most causes are minor and reversible. A few aren't, which is why the list is worth going through.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Low fluid intake:</strong> dehydration, heat, diarrhoea, vomiting. The most common cause in summer.</li><li><strong>Medications:</strong> diuretics, vasodilators, some antidepressants, heart and blood pressure medications, some sedatives. Check what you've started recently.</li><li><strong>After a meal:</strong> postprandial hypotension, especially in older adults and after large meals.</li><li><strong>Standing for long periods, prolonged bed rest, alcohol.</strong></li><li><strong>Pregnancy</strong>, especially in the first two trimesters.</li><li><strong>Heart:</strong> heart failure, arrhythmias, heart attack.</li><li><strong>Nervous system:</strong> diabetes with nerve damage, Parkinson's disease.</li><li><strong>Addison's disease</strong> (adrenal insufficiency), where blood pressure drops mainly on changing position.</li><li><strong>Bleeding or severe infection:</strong> low blood pressure with a fast pulse, cold, clammy skin. An emergency.</li></ul><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, causes table</a> and <a href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — hypotension</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="pe-loc" /><span class="eyebrow">The European guideline</span><h2>What to do when you have low blood pressure and feel dizzy</h2><p class="section-lead">The steps below come from the ESC guideline and NHS recommendations. They work within minutes and cost nothing.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Sit or lie down immediately</strong>, with your legs raised above heart level. If you can't, sit with your head between your knees.</li><li><strong>Counter-pressure manoeuvres:</strong> cross your legs and tense your thighs and buttocks, clench your fists, rise onto your toes. The guideline rates these class IIa, meaning recommended.</li><li><strong>Drink water.</strong> The guideline mentions rapid water intake; adequate hydration carries the same class of recommendation.</li><li><strong>Get up slowly</strong>, in stages: sit on the edge of the bed, then stand, with support.</li></ul><p>Long term, for confirmed orthostatic hypotension, the guideline recommends 2–3 litres of fluids a day, extra salt only on a doctor's advice, compression stockings, sleeping with the head of the bed raised, and cutting back on medications that lower blood pressure. Midodrine and fludrocortisone exist, but they're a specialist's decision, by prescription.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, section 5.3</a> and <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — fainting</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-nu-ajuta" /><span class="eyebrow">Sugar water, vitamins, teas</span><h2>What actually raises low blood pressure, and what only seems to</h2><p class="section-lead">The remedies most people look for don't appear in any European guideline. They aren't dangerous, but they don't do what people think either.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Sugar water:</strong> the guidelines recommend water; sugar doesn't appear anywhere. Plain water does the same job.</li><li><strong>Coffee:</strong> a 2021 systematic review found only very small studies with inconsistent results, and recommends caffeine only after evidence-based treatments have been exhausted. It isn't a treatment.</li><li><strong>Vitamins:</strong> no vitamin appears in the guidelines as a treatment for low blood pressure. If the hypotension comes from anaemia or an endocrine condition, the underlying cause is treated, after testing.</li><li><strong>Teas, chocolate, extra salt:</strong> no evidence. The ESC guideline allows for increased salt intake only as a doctor-directed measure, in selected patients.</li></ul><div class="alert-warn"><strong>When to call 112</strong>Fainting with chest pain, laboured breathing, a fast or irregular heartbeat, confusion, weakness on one side of the body, or slurred speech. Fainting during exercise or while lying down. Black stools, vomiting blood, high fever with low blood pressure, cold and clammy skin. The person doesn't fully recover within a minute. Calling 112 is free, from any network.</div><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021, caffeine in orthostatic hypotension</a>; <a href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — the 112 emergency service</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cand-la-medic" /><span class="eyebrow">Not an emergency, but worth an appointment</span><h2>When to see a doctor for low blood pressure</h2><p class="section-lead">When the dizziness keeps recurring, when you've fainted once with no explanation, or when the low blood pressure appeared alongside a new medication.</p><p>A family doctor or general practitioner can do the three things that matter: measuring blood pressure lying down and standing up, reviewing your medication list, and a basic set of tests, full blood count, blood glucose, thyroid function, electrolytes, plus an electrocardiogram. In an <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">online doctor consultation</a> with Global Health, you can go through your history and medication list and get <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">referrals for tests</a>. The standing measurement and the ECG still need to be done in person.</p><p>Beforehand, measure for seven days, morning and evening, two readings a minute apart, seated, after five minutes of rest, with a validated upper-arm blood pressure monitor. A single low reading on a hot day doesn't mean anything; a low average, together with symptoms, does.</p><p class="cite-note">Measurement protocol from the <a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2024 guideline</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="global-health" /><span class="eyebrow">Global Health România</span><h2>The next step</h2><p class="section-lead">You can carry out the on-the-spot steps yourself. The doctor establishes the cause.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Online doctor consultation</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Referrals and tests</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Normal blood pressure by age</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Doctors in România</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/contact">Contact Global Health</a></li></ul><div class="cta-box"><h3>Repeated dizziness or an unexplained fainting spell?</h3><p>A doctor reviews your symptoms and medications and orders the appropriate tests. This doesn't replace 112 in an emergency.</p><div class="cta-btns"><a class="btn-primary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Book a consultation</a><a blogTranslations.seoDesc: What low blood pressure means, the common causes, the steps recommended by the European guideline when you feel dizzy, why sugar water doesn't help, and when it's an emergency.

blogTranslations.title: Tensão baixa: porque acontece, o que fazer na hora e quando não esperar mais
blogTranslations.excerpt: Abaixo de 90/60 sem sintomas não é doença. Com tonturas e desmaio, é. As causas mais frequentes, as manobras que realmente sobem a tensão em poucos minutos, o que não ajuda e a lista curta para o 112.

</style><main class="gh-blog" lang="pt"><header class="article-intro"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="hero-brandline"><strong>Global Health</strong> · Cuidados de saúde a qualquer hora, em qualquer lugar <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog">Medicina geral</a></div><span class="eyebrow">România · Guia de hipotensão</span><h1>Tensão baixa: causas, o que fazer na hora e quando ir ao médico</h1><p class="hero-deck">Uma tensão de 9 por 6 em alguém que se sente bem não se trata. A mesma tensão com tonturas, visão turva ou desmaio tem causas que podem ser encontradas.</p><p class="intro-lead"><strong>A tensão baixa</strong>, ou seja, abaixo de 90/60 mmHg, não é uma doença em si. Se não tiver sintomas, as orientações clínicas são claras: não precisa de tratamento. O problema surge quando a tensão desce 20 mmHg ou mais ao levantar-se e provoca tonturas, escurecimento da visão ou desmaio. Nesse caso, a solução imediata é sentar-se ou deitar-se com as pernas elevadas, beber água e cruzar as pernas contraindo os músculos. Água com açúcar, vitaminas e chás não constam em nenhuma orientação clínica. Um desmaio com dor no peito, dificuldade em respirar ou confusão significa ligar para o 112.</p><div class="hero-facts"><span class="hero-fact">Abaixo de 90/60 mmHg sem sintomas: geralmente não precisa de tratamento</span><span class="hero-fact">Queda de 20/10 mmHg ao levantar-se, em 3 minutos: hipotensão ortostática</span><span class="hero-fact">Na hora: sentado ou deitado, pernas elevadas, água, músculos contraídos</span></div><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn-lime" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241">Guia da ESC sobre síncope</a><a class="btn-ghost" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Valores normais de tensão por idade</a></div></div><aside class="hero-panel"><span class="meta-chip">A ordem certa</span><p class="intro-support">Meça corretamente, durante sete dias, antes de se considerar hipotenso.</p><p class="intro-support">Procure a causa antes do remédio: desidratação, calor, um medicamento novo, uma refeição grande.</p><p class="intro-support">Um desmaio recorrente investiga-se, não se trata com café.</p><div class="hero-author"><div aria-hidden="true" class="hero-author-mark">GH</div><div><strong>Equipa Médica Global Health</strong></div></div><span class="hero-review-line">Revisto pela equipa médica da Global Health.</span></aside></header><nav class="article-nav"><div class="article-nav-inner"><span class="article-nav-label">Neste guia</span><div class="article-nav-list"><a href="#ce-inseamna">O que significa</a><a href="#cauze">Causas</a><a href="#pe-loc">O que fazer na hora</a><a href="#ce-nu-ajuta">O que não ajuda</a><a href="#cand-la-medic">Quando ir ao médico</a><a href="#faq">Perguntas frequentes</a></div></div></nav><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-inseamna" /><span class="eyebrow">Definições</span><h2>O que significa tensão baixa e quando é importante</h2><p class="section-lead">Sob o mesmo nome escondem-se duas situações diferentes, e apenas uma delas precisa de tratamento.</p><p>A primeira é a tensão constantemente baixa, abaixo de 90/60 mmHg, em alguém que se sente bem. O NHS e o NHLBI dizem o mesmo: sem sintomas, geralmente não se trata. A segunda é a hipotensão ortostática: a orientação europeia define-a como uma queda da sistólica de pelo menos 20 mmHg, ou da diastólica de 10 mmHg, nos primeiros 3 minutos após levantar-se. É esta que causa a tontura ao sair da cama e o escurecimento da visão, e é aqui que vale a pena procurar a causa.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Guia da ESC de 2018 sobre síncope</a>, <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — tensão arterial baixa</a>, <a href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI</a>. Consultado a 7 de setembro de 2026.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cauze" /><span class="eyebrow">De onde vem</span><h2>Causas frequentes da tensão baixa</h2><p class="section-lead">A maioria das causas são banais e reversíveis. Algumas não são, por isso vale a pena percorrer a lista.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Pouca ingestão de líquidos:</strong> desidratação, calor, diarreia, vómitos. A causa mais frequente no verão.</li><li><strong>Medicamentos:</strong> diuréticos, vasodilatadores, alguns antidepressivos, medicamentos para o coração e a tensão, alguns sedativos. Verifique o que começou a tomar recentemente.</li><li><strong>Depois das refeições:</strong> hipotensão pós-prandial, sobretudo em idosos e após refeições grandes.</li><li><strong>Ficar muito tempo em pé, repouso prolongado na cama, álcool.</strong></li><li><strong>Gravidez</strong>, sobretudo nos primeiros dois trimestres.</li><li><strong>Coração:</strong> insuficiência cardíaca, arritmias, enfarte.</li><li><strong>Sistema nervoso:</strong> diabetes com afeção dos nervos, doença de Parkinson.</li><li><strong>Doença de Addison</strong> (insuficiência suprarrenal), em que a tensão desce sobretudo com a mudança de posição.</li><li><strong>Hemorragia ou infeção grave:</strong> tensão baixa com pulso rápido, pele fria e suada. Urgência.</li></ul><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, tabela das causas</a> e <a href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — hipotensão</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="pe-loc" /><span class="eyebrow">A orientação europeia</span><h2>O que fazer quando tem tensão baixa e sente tonturas</h2><p class="section-lead">As manobras abaixo são as do guia da ESC e das recomendações do NHS. Funcionam em minutos e não custam nada.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Sente-se ou deite-se imediatamente</strong>, com as pernas elevadas acima do nível do coração. Se não conseguir, sente-se com a cabeça entre os joelhos.</li><li><strong>Manobras de contrapressão:</strong> cruze as pernas e contraia as coxas e as nádegas, cerre os punhos, eleve-se na ponta dos pés. O guia classifica-as como IIa, ou seja, recomendadas.</li><li><strong>Beba água.</strong> O guia menciona a ingestão rápida de água; a hidratação adequada está na mesma classe de recomendação.</li><li><strong>Levante-se devagar</strong>, por etapas: sente-se na borda da cama, depois fique de pé, com apoio.</li></ul><p>A longo prazo, em caso de hipotensão ortostática confirmada, o guia recomenda 2 a 3 litros de líquidos por dia, sal a mais apenas por indicação médica, meias de compressão, dormir com a cabeceira da cama elevada e reduzir os medicamentos que baixam a tensão. A midodrina e a fludrocortisona existem, mas são decisão de um especialista, com receita médica.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, secção 5.3</a> e <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — desmaios</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-nu-ajuta" /><span class="eyebrow">Água com açúcar, vitaminas, chás</span><h2>O que sobe a tensão baixa e o que só parece subi-la</h2><p class="section-lead">Os remédios que a maioria das pessoas procura não constam em nenhum guia europeu. Não são perigosos, mas também não fazem o que se pensa sobre eles.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Água com açúcar:</strong> os guias recomendam água; o açúcar não aparece em lado nenhum. A água simples faz o mesmo efeito.</li><li><strong>Café:</strong> uma revisão sistemática de 2021 encontrou apenas estudos muito pequenos, com resultados inconsistentes, e recomenda a cafeína apenas depois de esgotados os tratamentos com evidência. Não é um tratamento.</li><li><strong>Vitaminas:</strong> nenhuma vitamina consta nos guias como tratamento da tensão baixa. Se a hipotensão vier de uma anemia ou de uma doença endócrina, trata-se a causa, depois de feitas as análises.</li><li><strong>Chás, chocolate, sal a mais:</strong> sem evidência. O guia da ESC prevê o aumento da ingestão de sal apenas como medida indicada pelo médico, em doentes selecionados.</li></ul><div class="alert-warn"><strong>Quando ligar para o 112</strong>Desmaio com dor no peito, dificuldade em respirar, batimentos cardíacos rápidos ou irregulares, confusão, fraqueza num lado do corpo ou fala arrastada. Desmaio durante o esforço ou deitado na cama. Fezes negras, vómitos com sangue, febre alta com tensão baixa, pele fria e suada. A pessoa não recupera totalmente ao fim de um minuto. A chamada para o 112 é gratuita, de qualquer rede.</div><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021, cafeína na hipotensão ortostática</a>; <a href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — o serviço de emergência 112</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cand-la-medic" /><span class="eyebrow">Sem urgência, mas com marcação</span><h2>Quando ir ao médico por tensão baixa</h2><p class="section-lead">Quando as tonturas se repetem, quando desmaiou uma vez sem explicação, ou quando a tensão baixa surgiu ao mesmo tempo que um medicamento novo.</p><p>Um médico de família ou um clínico geral pode fazer as três coisas que importam: medir a tensão deitado e em pé, rever a lista de medicamentos e um conjunto de análises básicas, hemograma, glicemia, função tiroideia, eletrólitos, além de um eletrocardiograma. Numa <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">consulta com um médico online</a> na Global Health pode rever o histórico e a lista de medicamentos e receber <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">referenciações para análises</a>. A medição ortostática e o ECG continuam a ter de ser feitos presencialmente.</p><p>Antes disso, meça durante sete dias, de manhã e à noite, duas leituras com um minuto de intervalo, sentado, após cinco minutos de repouso, com um tensiómetro de braço validado. Um único valor baixo num dia quente não significa nada; uma média baixa, acompanhada de sintomas, é que conta.</p><p class="cite-note">Protocolo de medição do <a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">guia da ESC de 2024</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="global-health" /><span class="eyebrow">Global Health România</span><h2>O próximo passo</h2><p class="section-lead">As manobras imediatas pode fazê-las sozinho. A causa é o médico que a determina.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Consulta com médico online</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Referenciações e exames</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Tensão arterial normal por idade</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Médicos na România</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/contact">Contacte a Global Health</a></li></ul><div class="cta-box"><h3>Tonturas repetidas ou um desmaio inexplicado?</h3><p>Um médico revê os sintomas e os medicamentos e indica as análises adequadas. Não substitui o 112 numa urgência.</p><div class="cta-btns"><a class="btn-primary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Marcar uma consulta</a><a class="btn-secondary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Ver os médicos</a></div></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="sources" /><span class="eyebrow">Fontes médicas</span><h2>Fontes deste guia</h2><p class="section-lead">Guias europeus e fontes institucionais, consultados a 7 de setembro de 2026.</p><div class="institution-bar"><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018 — Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2024 — Guidelines for elevated blood pressure and hypertension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Low blood pressure (hypotension)</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Fainting</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021 — caffeine for orthostatic hypotension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — Serviciul de urgență 112</a></div><p class="cite-note">Os valores-limiar são os dos guias; o médico interpreta-os em função da idade, da gravidez e de doenças associadas.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="faq" /><span class="eyebrow">Perguntas frequentes</span><h2>Perguntas sobre a tensão baixa</h2><div class="faq-section"><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Uma tensão de 9 por 6 é perigosa?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Sem sintomas, geralmente não, e não se trata. Com tonturas, desmaio, ou se surgiu ao mesmo tempo que um medicamento novo, vale a pena marcar uma consulta.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">O que devo beber quando tenho a tensão baixa?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Água, bebida rapidamente. O açúcar não traz nada a mais. Quanto ao café, a evidência é muito fraca.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">O que sobe a tensão baixa rapidamente?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Sentar-se ou deitar-se com as pernas elevadas, cruzar as pernas e contrair os músculos, e água. São as manobras do guia europeu. Os medicamentos que sobem a tensão são apenas com receita médica.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Quando é que a tensão baixa é uma urgência?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Quando vem com desmaio e dor no peito, dificuldade em respirar, confusão, hemorragia, febre alta ou pele fria e húmida. Ligue para o 112.</p></div></details></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><div class="disclaimer"><strong>Aviso médico e de emergência</strong>Informação geral válida em setembro de 2026; não substitui a consulta médica nem constitui indicação de tratamento. Em caso de urgência, ligue para o 112.</div></div></section></main>
blogTranslations.seoTitle: Tensão baixa: causas, o que fazer e quando ligar para o 112
blogTranslations.seoDesc: O que significa tensão baixa, as causas frequentes, as manobras recomendadas pelo guia europeu quando sente tonturas, porque é que a água com açúcar não ajuda e quando é uma urgência.
blogTranslations.coverImageAlt: Mulher sentada num degrau no hall de um prédio, com um copo de água na mão e a mão de outra pessoa no ombro, depois de uma tontura.

blogTranslations.title: Tensión baja: por qué aparece, qué hacer en el momento y cuándo no esperar más
blogTranslations.excerpt: Por debajo de 90/60 sin síntomas no es una enfermedad. Con mareos y desmayo, sí lo es. Las causas más frecuentes, las maniobras que realmente suben la tensión en pocos minutos, lo que no ayuda y la lista breve para llamar al 112.

Algunas no lo son, por eso merece la pena repasar la lista.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Poca ingesta de líquidos:</strong> deshidratación, calor, diarrea, vómitos. La causa más frecuente en verano.</li><li><strong>Medicamentos:</strong> diuréticos, vasodilatadores, algunos antidepresivos, medicamentos para el corazón y la tensión, algunos sedantes. Compruebe qué ha empezado a tomar recientemente.</li><li><strong>Después de comer:</strong> hipotensión posprandial, sobre todo en personas mayores y tras comidas copiosas.</li><li><strong>Estar de pie mucho tiempo, reposo prolongado en cama, alcohol.</strong></li><li><strong>Embarazo</strong>, especialmente en los dos primeros trimestres.</li><li><strong>Corazón:</strong> insuficiencia cardíaca, arritmias, infarto.</li><li><strong>Sistema nervioso:</strong> diabetes con afectación de los nervios, enfermedad de Parkinson.</li><li><strong>Enfermedad de Addison</strong> (insuficiencia suprarrenal), en la que la tensión baja sobre todo al cambiar de posición.</li><li><strong>Hemorragia o infección grave:</strong> tensión baja con pulso rápido, piel fría y sudorosa. Urgencia.</li></ul><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, tabla de causas</a> y <a href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — hipotensión</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="pe-loc" /><span class="eyebrow">La guía europea</span><h2>Qué hacer cuando tiene la tensión baja y se marea</h2><p class="section-lead">Las maniobras siguientes son las de la guía de la ESC y las recomendaciones del NHS. Funcionan en minutos y no cuestan nada.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Siéntese o túmbese de inmediato</strong>, con las piernas elevadas por encima del nivel del corazón. Si no puede, siéntese con la cabeza entre las rodillas.</li><li><strong>Maniobras de contrapresión:</strong> cruce las piernas y tense los muslos y los glúteos, apriete los puños, póngase de puntillas. La guía las clasifica como IIa, es decir, recomendadas.</li><li><strong>Beba agua.</strong> La guía menciona la ingesta rápida de agua; la hidratación adecuada tiene la misma clase de recomendación.</li><li><strong>Levántese despacio</strong>, por etapas: al borde de la cama, luego de pie, con apoyo.</li></ul><p>A largo plazo, en la hipotensión ortostática confirmada, la guía recomienda de 2 a 3 litros de líquidos al día, sal adicional solo por indicación médica, medias de compresión, dormir con el cabecero de la cama elevado y reducir los medicamentos que bajan la tensión. La midodrina y la fludrocortisona existen, pero son decisión de un especialista, con receta.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, sección 5.3</a> y <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — desmayos</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-nu-ajuta" /><span class="eyebrow">Agua con azúcar, vitaminas, infusiones</span><h2>Qué sube realmente la tensión baja y qué solo lo parece</h2><p class="section-lead">Los remedios que busca la mayoría de las personas no aparecen en ninguna guía europea. No son peligrosos, pero tampoco hacen lo que se cree.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>El agua con azúcar:</strong> las guías recomiendan agua; el azúcar no aparece en ninguna parte. El agua sola hace el mismo efecto.</li><li><strong>El café:</strong> una revisión sistemática de 2021 encontró solo estudios muy pequeños, con resultados inconsistentes, y recomienda la cafeína solo después de agotar los tratamientos con evidencia. No es un tratamiento.</li><li><strong>Las vitaminas:</strong> ninguna vitamina aparece en las guías como tratamiento de la tensión baja. Si la hipotensión viene de una anemia o de una enfermedad endocrina, se trata la causa, tras las pruebas.</li><li><strong>Infusiones, chocolate, sal adicional:</strong> sin evidencia. La guía de la ESC prevé el aumento de la ingesta de sal solo como medida indicada por el médico, en pacientes seleccionados.</li></ul><div class="alert-warn"><strong>Cuándo llamar al 112</strong>Desmayo con dolor en el pecho, dificultad para respirar, latidos rápidos o irregulares del corazón, confusión, debilidad en un lado del cuerpo o habla enredada. Desmayo durante el esfuerzo o estando tumbado en la cama. Heces negras, vómitos con sangre, fiebre alta con tensión baja, piel fría y sudorosa. La persona no se recupera del todo en un minuto. La llamada al 112 es gratuita, desde cualquier red.</div><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021, cafeína en la hipotensión ortostática</a>; <a href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — el servicio de emergencias 112</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cand-la-medic" /><span class="eyebrow">Sin urgencia, pero con cita</span><h2>Cuándo acudir al médico por tensión baja</h2><p class="section-lead">Cuando los mareos se repiten, cuando se ha desmayado una vez sin explicación, o cuando la tensión baja apareció junto con un medicamento nuevo.</p><p>Un médico de familia o un médico generalista puede hacer las tres cosas que importan: medir la tensión tumbado y de pie, revisar la lista de medicamentos y un conjunto de pruebas básicas, hemograma, glucemia, función tiroidea, electrolitos, más un electrocardiograma. En una <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">consulta con un médico online</a> de Global Health puede repasar el historial y la lista de medicamentos y recibir <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">volantes para pruebas</a>. La medición ortostática y el ECG siguen requiriendo una visita presencial.</p><p>Antes, mida durante siete días, por la mañana y por la noche, dos lecturas con un minuto de diferencia, sentado, tras cinco minutos de reposo, con un tensiómetro de brazo validado. Un solo valor bajo en un día caluroso no significa nada; una media baja, junto con síntomas, sí importa.</p><p class="cite-note">Protocolo de medición de la <a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">guía de la ESC de 2024</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="global-health" /><span class="eyebrow">Global Health România</span><h2>El siguiente paso</h2><p class="section-lead">Las maniobras del momento puede hacerlas usted mismo. La causa la determina el médico.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Consulta con médico online</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Volantes y pruebas</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Tensión arterial normal por edad</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Médicos en România</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/contact">Contactar con Global Health</a></li></ul><div class="cta-box"><h3>¿Mareos repetidos o un desmayo sin explicación?</h3><p>Un médico revisa los síntomas y los medicamentos e indica las pruebas adecuadas. No sustituye al 112 en una urgencia.</p><div class="cta-btns"><a class="btn-primary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Reservar una consulta</a><a class="btn-secondary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Ver los médicos</a></div></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="sources" /><span class="eyebrow">Fuentes médicas</span><h2>Fuentes de esta guía</h2><p class="section-lead">Guías europeas y fuentes institucionales, consultadas el 7 de septiembre de 2026.</p><div class="institution-bar"><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018 — Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2024 — Guidelines for elevated blood pressure and hypertension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Low blood pressure (hypotension)</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Fainting</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021 — caffeine for orthostatic hypotension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — Serviciul de urgență 112</a></div><p class="cite-note">Los valores umbral son los de las guías; el médico los interpreta según la edad, el embarazo y las enfermedades asociadas.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="faq" /><span class="eyebrow">Preguntas frecuentes</span><h2>Preguntas sobre la tensión baja</h2><div class="faq-section"><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">¿Es peligrosa una tensión de 9 con 6?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Sin síntomas, normalmente no, y no se trata. Con mareos, desmayo, o si apareció junto con un medicamento nuevo, merece la pena una consulta.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">¿Qué debo beber cuando tengo la tensión baja?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Agua, bebida rápido. El azúcar no aporta nada más. En cuanto al café, la evidencia es muy débil.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">¿Qué sube la tensión baja rápidamente?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Sentarse o tumbarse con las piernas elevadas, cruzar las piernas y tensar los músculos, y el agua. Son las maniobras de la guía europea. Los medicamentos que suben la tensión son solo con receta.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">¿Cuándo es la tensión baja una urgencia?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Cuando viene con desmayo y dolor en el pecho, dificultad para respirar, confusión, hemorragia, fiebre alta o piel fría y húmeda. Llame al 112.</p></div></details></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><div class="disclaimer"><strong>Aviso médico y de emergencia</strong>Información general válida en septiembre de 2026; no sustituye la consulta médica ni constituye una indicación de tratamiento. En caso de urgencia, llame al 112.</div></div></section></main>
blogTranslations.seoTitle: Tensión baja: causas, qué hacer y cuándo llamar al 112
blogTranslations.seoDesc: Qué significa la tensión baja, las causas frecuentes, las maniobras recomendadas por la guía europea cuando se marea, por qué el agua con azúcar no ayuda y cuándo es una urgencia.
blogTranslations.coverImageAlt: Mujer sentada en un escalón del portal de un edificio, con un vaso de agua en la mano y la mano de otra persona en el hombro, después de un mareo.

blogTranslations.title: Nízký krevní tlak: proč se objevuje, co dělat hned a kdy už nečekat
blogTranslations.excerpt: Pod 90/60 bez příznaků není nemoc. Se závratěmi a mdlobou ano. Časté příčiny, manévry, které tlak skutečně zvednou během pár minut, co nepomáhá a krátký seznam pro volání na 112.

class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-inseamna" /><span class="eyebrow">Definice</span><h2>Co znamená nízký krevní tlak a kdy na něm záleží</h2><p class="section-lead">Pod stejným názvem se skrývají dvě různé situace a léčbu potřebuje jen jedna z nich.</p><p>První je trvale nízký tlak, pod 90/60 mmHg, u někoho, kdo se cítí dobře. NHS i NHLBI říkají totéž: bez příznaků se obvykle neléčí. Druhou je ortostatická hypotenze: evropské doporučení ji definuje jako pokles systolického tlaku alespoň o 20 mmHg nebo diastolického o 10 mmHg během prvních 3 minut po postavení se. Ta způsobuje závrať při vstávání z postele a černo před očima, a právě u ní se vyplatí hledat příčinu.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Doporučení ESC 2018 pro synkopu</a>, <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — nízký krevní tlak</a>, <a href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI</a>. Navštíveno 7. září 2026.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cauze" /><span class="eyebrow">Odkud pochází</span><h2>Časté příčiny nízkého krevního tlaku</h2><p class="section-lead">Většina příčin je banální a vratná. Několik jich není, proto se vyplatí projít celý seznam.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Nedostatek tekutin:</strong> dehydratace, horko, průjem, zvracení. Nejčastější příčina v létě.</li><li><strong>Léky:</strong> diuretika, vazodilatancia, některá antidepresiva, léky na srdce a tlak, některá sedativa. Zkontrolujte, co jste začali užívat nedávno.</li><li><strong>Po jídle:</strong> postprandiální hypotenze, zejména u starších lidí a po vydatných jídlech.</li><li><strong>Dlouhé stání, dlouhodobý klid na lůžku, alkohol.</strong></li><li><strong>Těhotenství</strong>, zejména v prvních dvou trimestrech.</li><li><strong>Srdce:</strong> srdeční selhání, arytmie, infarkt.</li><li><strong>Nervový systém:</strong> diabetes s poškozením nervů, Parkinsonova choroba.</li><li><strong>Addisonova choroba</strong> (nedostatečnost nadledvin), při které tlak klesá zejména při změně polohy.</li><li><strong>Krvácení nebo těžká infekce:</strong> nízký tlak s rychlým pulzem, studená a zpocená kůže. Urgentní stav.</li></ul><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, tabulka příčin</a> a <a href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — hypotenze</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="pe-loc" /><span class="eyebrow">Evropské doporučení</span><h2>Co dělat, když máte nízký tlak a je vám na omdlení</h2><p class="section-lead">Níže uvedené manévry pocházejí z doporučení ESC a z doporučení NHS. Fungují během minut a nic nestojí.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Ihned si sedněte nebo lehněte</strong>, s nohama zvednutýma nad úroveň srdce. Pokud nemůžete, seďte s hlavou mezi koleny.</li><li><strong>Protitlakové manévry:</strong> zkřižte nohy a napněte stehna a hýždě, zaťte pěsti, postavte se na špičky. Doporučení je řadí do třídy IIa, tedy doporučené.</li><li><strong>Napijte se vody.</strong> Doporučení zmiňuje rychlé vypití vody; přiměřená hydratace má stejnou třídu doporučení.</li><li><strong>Vstávejte pomalu</strong>, po etapách: na okraj postele, pak do stoje, s oporou.</li></ul><p>Dlouhodobě se u potvrzené ortostatické hypotenze doporučuje 2–3 litry tekutin denně, extra sůl jen na doporučení lékaře, kompresní punčochy, spaní se zvýšeným čelem postele a omezení léků, které snižují tlak. Midodrin a fludrokortison existují, ale jsou rozhodnutím specialisty, na předpis.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, oddíl 5.3</a> a <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — mdloby</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-nu-ajuta" /><span class="eyebrow">Slazená voda, vitaminy, bylinné čaje</span><h2>Co skutečně zvedá nízký tlak a co to jen vypadá, že zvedá</h2><p class="section-lead">Prostředky, které hledá většina lidí, se v žádném evropském doporučení neobjevují. Nejsou nebezpečné, ale nedělají to, co se o nich myslí.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Slazená voda:</strong> doporučení radí vodu; cukr se nikde neobjevuje. Obyčejná voda funguje stejně.</li><li><strong>Káva:</strong> systematický přehled z roku 2021 našel jen velmi malé studie s nejednotnými výsledky a doporučuje kofein až po vyčerpání léčby s důkazy. Není to léčba.</li><li><strong>Vitaminy:</strong> žádný vitamin se v doporučeních neobjevuje jako léčba nízkého tlaku. Pokud hypotenze pramení z anemie nebo endokrinního onemocnění, léčí se příčina, po vyšetřeních.</li><li><strong>Bylinné čaje, čokoláda, extra sůl:</strong> bez důkazů. Doporučení ESC počítá se zvýšeným příjmem soli jen jako s opatřením podle pokynu lékaře, u vybraných pacientů.</li></ul><div class="alert-warn"><strong>Kdy volat 112</strong>Mdloba s bolestí na hrudi, ztíženým dýcháním, rychlým nebo nepravidelným tepem srdce, zmateností, slabostí na jedné straně těla nebo nesrozumitelnou řečí. Mdloba během námahy nebo vleže na lůžku. Černá stolice, zvracení krve, vysoká horečka s nízkým tlakem, studená a zpocená kůže. Člověk se do minuty plně nevzpamatuje. Volání na 112 je zdarma, z jakékoli sítě.</div><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021, kofein u ortostatické hypotenze</a>; <a href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — tísňová linka 112</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cand-la-medic" /><span class="eyebrow">Bez urgence, ale s objednáním</span><h2>Kdy jít k lékaři kvůli nízkému tlaku</h2><p class="section-lead">Když se závratě opakují, když jste jednou omdleli bez vysvětlení, nebo když se nízký tlak objevil zároveň s novým lékem.</p><p>Praktický lékař dokáže udělat tři věci, na kterých záleží: změřit tlak vleže a vestoje, projít seznam léků a základní sadu vyšetření, krevní obraz, glykémii, funkci štítné žlázy, elektrolyty, plus elektrokardiogram. V rámci <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">online konzultace s lékařem</a> u Global Health můžete projít anamnézu i seznam léků a získat <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">žádanky na vyšetření</a>. Ortostatické měření a EKG je stále třeba udělat osobně.</p><p>Předtím měřte sedm dní, ráno a večer, dvě měření s odstupem minuty, vsedě, po pěti minutách klidu, validovaným tlakoměrem na paži. Jedna nízká hodnota v horkém dni nic neznamená; nízký průměr spolu s příznaky ano.</p><p class="cite-note">Protokol měření z <a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">doporučení ESC 2024</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="global-health" /><span class="eyebrow">Global Health România</span><h2>Další krok</h2><p class="section-lead">Manévry na místě zvládnete sami. Příčinu určí lékař.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Online konzultace s lékařem</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Žádanky a vyšetření</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Normální krevní tlak podle věku</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Lékaři v România</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/contact">Kontaktujte Global Health</a></li></ul><div class="cta-box"><h3>Opakované závratě nebo nevysvětlená mdloba?</h3><p>Lékař projde příznaky a léky a určí vhodná vyšetření. Nenahrazuje 112 v urgentním případě.</p><div class="cta-btns"><a class="btn-primary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Objednat konzultaci</a><a class="btn-secondary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Zobrazit lékaře</a></div></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div zdroje, navštíveno 7. září 2026.</p><div class="institution-bar"><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018 — Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Fainting</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021 — caffeine for orthostatic Serviciul de urgență 112</a></div><p class="cite-note">Prahové hodnoty pocházejí z doporučení; lékař je interpretuje podle věku, těhotenství a přidružených onemocnění.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="faq" /><span class="eyebrow">Časté dotazy</span><h2>Otázky o nízkém krevním tlaku</h2><div class="faq-section"><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Je tlak 9 na 6 nebezpečný?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Bez příznaků obvykle ne a neléčí se. Se závratěmi, mdlobou, nebo pokud se objevil zároveň s novým lékem, stojí za konzultaci.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Co pít, když mám nízký tlak?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Vodu, vypitou rychle. Cukr nic navíc nepřináší. Pokud jde o kávu, důkazy jsou velmi slabé.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Co rychle zvedne nízký tlak?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Posadit se nebo lehnout si se zvednutýma nohama, zkřížit nohy a napnout svaly, a voda. To jsou manévry z evropského doporučení. Léky, které zvyšují tlak, jsou pouze na předpis.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Kdy je nízký tlak urgentní stav?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Když přichází s mdlobou a bolestí na hrudi, ztíženým dýcháním, zmateností, krvácením, vysokou horečkou nebo studenou a vlhkou kůží. Volejte 112.</p></div></details></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><div class="disclaimer"><strong>Lékařské a nouzové upozornění</strong>Obecné informace platné v září 2026; nenahrazují lékařskou konzultaci a nejsou pokynem k léčbě. V urgentním případě volejte 112.</div></div></section></main>
blogTranslations.seoTitle: Nízký krevní tlak: příčiny, co dělat a kdy volat 112
blogTranslations.seoDesc: Co znamená nízký krevní tlak, časté příčiny, manévry doporučené evropským doporučením při závratích, proč slazená voda nepomáhá a kdy jde o urgentní stav.
blogTranslations.coverImageAlt: Žena sedící na schodu na chodbě bytového domu, se sklenicí vody v ruce a rukou jiné osoby na rameni, po záchvatu závratě.

blogTranslations.title: Niedriger Blutdruck: warum er entsteht, was sofort zu tun ist und wann man nicht mehr warten sollte
blogTranslations.excerpt: Unter 90/60 ohne Beschwerden ist keine Krankheit. Mit Schwindel und Ohnmacht schon. Die häufigsten Ursachen, die Maßnahmen, die den Blutdruck innerhalb weniger Minuten wirklich anheben, was nicht hilft, und die kurze Liste für den Notruf 112.

class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-inseamna" /><span class="eyebrow">Definitionen</span><h2>Was niedriger Blutdruck bedeutet und wann er wichtig ist</h2><p class="section-lead">Hinter demselben Namen verbergen sich zwei unterschiedliche Situationen, von denen nur eine eine Behandlung braucht.</p><p>Die erste ist der dauerhaft niedrige Blutdruck, unter 90/60 mmHg, bei jemandem, der sich gut fühlt. NHS und NHLBI sagen dasselbe: ohne Beschwerden wird er meist nicht behandelt. Die zweite ist die orthostatische Hypotonie: Die europäische Leitlinie definiert sie als einen Abfall des systolischen Werts um mindestens 20 mmHg oder des diastolischen Werts um 10 mmHg innerhalb der ersten 3 Minuten nach dem Aufstehen. Sie verursacht den Schwindel beim Aufstehen aus dem Bett und das Schwarzwerden vor den Augen, und genau bei ihr lohnt es sich, nach der Ursache zu suchen.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC-Leitlinie 2018 zur Synkope</a>, <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — niedriger Blutdruck</a>, <a href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI</a>. Abgerufen am 7. September 2026.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cauze" /><span class="eyebrow">Woher er kommt</span><h2>Häufige Ursachen für niedrigen Blutdruck</h2><p class="section-lead">Die meisten Ursachen sind harmlos und umkehrbar. Einige sind es nicht, deshalb lohnt sich ein Blick auf die Liste.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Zu wenig Flüssigkeit:</strong> Dehydrierung, Hitze, Durchfall, Erbrechen. Die häufigste Ursache im Sommer.</li><li><strong>Medikamente:</strong> Diuretika, Gefäßerweiterer, manche Antidepressiva, Herz- und Blutdruckmedikamente, manche Beruhigungsmittel. Prüfen Sie, was Sie kürzlich neu eingenommen haben.</li><li><strong>Nach dem Essen:</strong> postprandiale Hypotonie, vor allem bei älteren Menschen und nach üppigen Mahlzeiten.</li><li><strong>Langes Stehen, längere Bettruhe, Alkohol.</strong></li><li><strong>Schwangerschaft</strong>, besonders in den ersten beiden Trimestern.</li><li><strong>Herz:</strong> Herzinsuffizienz, Herzrhythmusstörungen, Herzinfarkt.</li><li><strong>Nervensystem:</strong> Diabetes mit Nervenschädigung, Parkinson-Krankheit.</li><li><strong>Morbus Addison</strong> (Nebenniereninsuffizienz), bei dem der Blutdruck vor allem bei Lageänderungen abfällt.</li><li><strong>Blutung oder schwere Infektion:</strong> niedriger Blutdruck mit schnellem Puls, kalter und schweißiger Haut. Ein Notfall.</li></ul><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, Ursachentabelle</a> und <a href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — Hypotonie</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="pe-loc" /><span class="eyebrow">Die europäische Leitlinie</span><h2>Was zu tun ist, wenn der Blutdruck niedrig ist und einem schwindelig wird</h2><p class="section-lead">Die folgenden Maßnahmen stammen aus der ESC-Leitlinie und den Empfehlungen des NHS. Sie wirken innerhalb von Minuten und kosten nichts.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Setzen oder legen Sie sich sofort hin</strong>, mit den Beinen über Herzhöhe angehoben. Wenn das nicht möglich ist, setzen Sie sich mit dem Kopf zwischen den Knien hin.</li><li><strong>Gegendruckmanöver:</strong> Beine überkreuzen und Oberschenkel und Gesäß anspannen, Fäuste ballen, sich auf die Zehenspitzen stellen. Die Leitlinie stuft dies als Klasse IIa ein, also als empfohlen.</li><li><strong>Wasser trinken.</strong> Die Leitlinie erwähnt das rasche Trinken von Wasser; eine ausreichende Flüssigkeitszufuhr fällt in dieselbe Empfehlungsklasse.</li><li><strong>Langsam aufstehen</strong>, in Etappen: zunächst an den Bettrand setzen, dann mit Unterstützung aufstehen.</li></ul><p>Langfristig empfiehlt die Leitlinie bei bestätigter orthostatischer Hypotonie 2 bis 3 Liter Flüssigkeit pro Tag, zusätzliches Salz nur nach ärztlicher Anweisung, Kompressionsstrümpfe, das Schlafen mit erhöhtem Kopfteil des Bettes und die Reduzierung blutdrucksenkender Medikamente. Midodrin und Fludrocortison gibt es, doch das ist eine Entscheidung des Facharztes, verschreibungspflichtig.</p><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018, Abschnitt 5.3</a> und <a href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Ohnmacht</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="ce-nu-ajuta" /><span class="eyebrow">Zuckerwasser, Vitamine, Tees</span><h2>Was niedrigen Blutdruck wirklich anhebt, und was es nur zu tun scheint</h2><p class="section-lead">Die Mittel, nach denen die meisten Menschen suchen, kommen in keiner europäischen Leitlinie vor. Sie sind nicht gefährlich, bewirken aber auch nicht das, was man ihnen zuschreibt.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><strong>Zuckerwasser:</strong> Die Leitlinien empfehlen Wasser; Zucker taucht nirgends auf. Normales Wasser bewirkt dasselbe.</li><li><strong>Kaffee:</strong> Eine systematische Übersichtsarbeit aus dem Jahr 2021 fand nur sehr kleine Studien mit uneinheitlichen Ergebnissen und empfiehlt Koffein erst, wenn evidenzbasierte Behandlungen ausgeschöpft sind. Er ist keine Behandlung.</li><li><strong>Vitamine:</strong> Kein Vitamin taucht in den Leitlinien als Behandlung von niedrigem Blutdruck auf. Kommt die Hypotonie von einer Anämie oder einer endokrinen Erkrankung, wird nach entsprechenden Untersuchungen die Ursache behandelt.</li><li><strong>Tees, Schokolade, zusätzliches Salz:</strong> ohne Nachweis. Die ESC-Leitlinie sieht eine erhöhte Salzzufuhr nur als ärztlich angeordnete Maßnahme bei ausgewählten Patienten vor.</li></ul><div class="alert-warn"><strong>Wann Sie den Notruf 112 wählen sollten</strong>Ohnmacht mit Brustschmerzen, Atemnot, schnellem oder unregelmäßigem Herzschlag, Verwirrtheit, Schwäche auf einer Körperseite oder verwaschener Sprache. Ohnmacht während körperlicher Anstrengung oder im Liegen. Schwarzer Stuhl, Bluterbrechen, hohes Fieber mit niedrigem Blutdruck, kalte und schweißige Haut. Die Person erlangt innerhalb einer Minute nicht vollständig das Bewusstsein zurück. Der Anruf beim Notruf 112 ist aus jedem Netz kostenlos.</div><p class="cite-note"><a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021, Koffein bei orthostatischer Hypotonie</a>; <a href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — der Notrufdienst 112</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="cand-la-medic" /><span class="eyebrow">Kein Notfall, aber ein Termin ist sinnvoll</span><h2>Wann man wegen niedrigem Blutdruck zum Arzt geht</h2><p class="section-lead">Wenn sich der Schwindel wiederholt, wenn Sie einmal ohne Erklärung ohnmächtig geworden sind, oder wenn der niedrige Blutdruck zusammen mit einem neuen Medikament aufgetreten ist.</p><p>Ein Hausarzt oder Allgemeinmediziner kann die drei wichtigen Dinge tun: den Blutdruck im Liegen und im Stehen messen, die Medikamentenliste durchgehen und eine Reihe von Basisuntersuchungen veranlassen, Blutbild, Blutzucker, Schilddrüsenfunktion, Elektrolyte, plus ein EKG. In einer <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Online-Arztkonsultation</a> bei Global Health können Sie die Vorgeschichte und die Medikamentenliste durchgehen und <a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Überweisungen für Untersuchungen</a> erhalten. Die orthostatische Messung und das EKG müssen weiterhin persönlich erfolgen.</p><p>Messen Sie vorher sieben Tage lang, morgens und abends, zwei Messungen im Abstand von einer Minute, im Sitzen, nach fünf Minuten Ruhe, mit einem validierten Oberarm-Blutdruckmessgerät. Ein einzelner niedriger Wert an einem heißen Tag bedeutet nichts; ein niedriger Durchschnitt zusammen mit Beschwerden zählt hingegen.</p><p class="cite-note">Messprotokoll aus der <a href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC-Leitlinie 2024</a>.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="global-health" /><span class="eyebrow">Global Health România</span><h2>Der nächste Schritt</h2><p class="section-lead">Die Sofortmaßnahmen können Sie selbst durchführen. Die Ursache stellt der Arzt fest.</p><ul class="check-list"><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Online-Arztkonsultation</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/trimiteri-si-investigatii">Überweisungen und Untersuchungen</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/blog/tensiune-arteriala-normala-varsta-adulti">Normaler Blutdruck nach Alter</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Ärzte in România</a></li><li><a href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/contact">Global Health kontaktieren</a></li></ul><div class="cta-box"><h3>Wiederholter Schwindel oder eine unerklärte Ohnmacht?</h3><p>Ein Arzt geht die Symptome und Medikamente durch und veranlasst die passenden Untersuchungen. Das ersetzt den Notruf 112 im Notfall nicht.</p><div class="cta-btns"><a class="btn-primary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/services/medic-online-romania">Termin vereinbaren</a><a class="btn-secondary" href="https://www.myglobalhealth.online/romania/ro/doctors">Ärzte ansehen</a></div></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="sources" /><span class="eyebrow">Medizinische Quellen</span><h2>Quellen dieses Ratgebers</h2><p class="section-lead">Europäische Leitlinien und institutionelle Quellen, abgerufen am 7. September 2026.</p><div class="institution-bar"><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/39/21/1883/4939241" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2018 — Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/45/38/3912/7741010" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">ESC 2024 — Guidelines for elevated blood pressure and hypertension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/low-blood-pressure-hypotension/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Low blood pressure (hypotension)</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fainting/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHS — Fainting</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/low-blood-pressure" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">NHLBI — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007278.htm" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">MedlinePlus — Low blood pressure</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34143333/" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Clinical Autonomic Research 2021 — caffeine for orthostatic hypotension</a><a class="inst-link" href="https://serviciipublice.gov.ro/serviciu/serviciul-de-urgenta-112-asigurat-cetatenilor" rel="nofollow noopener noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gov.ro — Serviciul de urgență 112</a></div><p class="cite-note">Die Grenzwerte stammen aus den Leitlinien; der Arzt interpretiert sie abhängig von Alter, Schwangerschaft und Begleiterkrankungen.</p></div></section><section class="article-section section-forest"><div class="section-inner"><hr class="section-anchor" id="faq" /><span class="eyebrow">Häufige Fragen</span><h2>Fragen zu niedrigem Blutdruck</h2><div class="faq-section"><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Ist ein Blutdruck von 9 zu 6 gefährlich?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Ohne Beschwerden meist nicht, und er wird nicht behandelt. Bei Schwindel, Ohnmacht oder wenn er zusammen mit einem neuen Medikament aufgetreten ist, lohnt sich eine Konsultation.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Was soll ich trinken, wenn mein Blutdruck niedrig ist?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Wasser, schnell getrunken. Zucker bringt keinen zusätzlichen Nutzen. Für Kaffee ist die Evidenz sehr schwach.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Was hebt niedrigen Blutdruck schnell an?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Sich hinsetzen oder mit erhöhten Beinen hinlegen, die Beine überkreuzen und die Muskeln anspannen, und Wasser trinken. Das sind die Maßnahmen aus der europäischen Leitlinie. Medikamente, die den Blutdruck erhöhen, gibt es nur auf Rezept.</p></div></details><details class="faq-item"><summary class="faq-q">Wann ist niedriger Blutdruck ein Notfall?</summary><div class="faq-a"><p>Wenn er mit Ohnmacht und Brustschmerzen, Atemnot, Verwirrtheit, Blutung, hohem Fieber oder kalter, feuchter Haut einhergeht. Rufen Sie den Notruf 112.</p></div></details></div></div></section><section class="article-section section-ivory"><div class="section-inner"><div class="disclaimer"><strong>Medizinischer und Notfallhinweis</strong>Allgemeine Informationen, gültig im September 2026; sie ersetzen keine ärztliche Beratung und stellen keine Behandlungsanweisung dar. Wählen Sie im Notfall den Notruf 112.</div></div></section></main>
blogTranslations.seoTitle: Niedriger Blutdruck: Ursachen, was zu tun ist und wann Sie 112 wählen
blogTranslations.seoDesc: Was niedriger Blutdruck bedeutet, die häufigsten Ursachen, die von der europäischen Leitlinie empfohlenen Maßnahmen bei Schwindel, warum Zuckerwasser nicht hilft und wann es ein Notfall ist.
